mapper.insert: INSERT INTO behavior (user_id, book_id, type) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{type})
mapper.select: SELECT MOD(user_id, 2) AS bucket, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'exposure' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exposures, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clicks FROM behavior GROUP BY MOD(user_id, 2)
